# <center> 3D World

<center>3D World is a resource pack made by SpaceBay that makes every non-3D item 3-dimensional. 3D World will be updated as new items are made 3D and as new Minecraft versions are released.</center>
‎
<center>All textures still have the vanilla feel, but a more spiced up and prestine look with perfect diagonols on items, consistent style, and colors taken straight from the vanilla resources so everything looks purely vanilla.</center>
‎
<center>No additional mods are required to load the resource pack.
